version.changelog:
- Setup is now organic and non-blocking—users can start minimal, adding files as needed.
- Workspace integration prompt moved to the beginning of setup for clarity.
- Preferences can now be learned from user behavior, reducing explicit questions.
- Core architecture and file requirements clarified for flexible, user-driven setup.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are consistent with a local garden-tracking assistant: it keeps data under ~/garden/, has no installs or external credentials, and only suggests writing to a central memory file with explicit consent.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match what the skill does: structured local memory, plant/zone/task/harvest tracking, and climate-aware planning. There are no unrelated env vars, binaries, or services requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions consistently restrict data to ~/garden/ and describe what to read/write (memory.md, plants/, zones/, logs). One action—adding an entry to the user's main memory file (MEMORY.md)—is allowed but only with explicit consent; this is the only instruction that writes outside ~/garden/. The skill also says it will "learn from behavior" and save inferred preferences, so users should understand it will record conversationally learned context into the garden files over time.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer beyond files the agent creates in ~/garden/ as part of normal operation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. All data handling is local and declared in the docs. No external API keys or telemetry are required.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (normal). The skill may be invoked autonomously (platform default). The only cross-skill/system write is the optional workspace integration entry to the user's main memory, which requires explicit consent—this increases the data's visibility to other sessions/skills and should be considered before approving.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This is an instruction-only, local-first garden tracker — low technical risk. Before enabling: 1) Confirm where your main MEMORY.md lives and whether you want Garden to add an entry there (it only does so with explicit consent). Adding that entry will make garden context visible to other sessions/skills that read the same memory. 2) Check file permissions for ~/garden so only intended users/processes can read it. 3) Be aware the skill saves conversationally learned details (climate hints, plant mentions) into ~/garden/memory.md; if you don't want that, decline workspace integration and tell the skill to pause logging. 4) No network access or credentials are requested by the skill, and there is no installer — the risk surface is primarily of accidental local data exposure, not remote exfiltration.
